Georgia Indigenous Diversity Consulting, LLC

Georgia Indigenous Diversity Consulting, LLC partnered with the City of East Point’s public arts division on the inaugural Standing Peachtree Native American Festival and Powwow in 2022. Visit East Point also credits the organization with producing the third annual festival.
